build_system: None - single HTML file, no build step required
test_framework: Node.js built-in test runner (node --test) for logic tests; manual browser testing for UI
verification_instructions: 1. Open index.html in a browser to play the game. 2. Run node --test minesweeper.test.js to verify game logic. 3. Verify all difficulty levels work. 4. Verify first-click safety, flagging, win/loss detection, timer, and restart.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - all files are self-contained with zero dependencies
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode - no npm install, no CDN links, no external dependencies. Everything must be vanilla HTML/CSS/JS. Node.js v22 is available for running tests.
contribution_requirements: No formal contribution guidelines in the repo.
key_patterns: Greenfield project - no existing patterns to follow. Will use clean separation of game logic (testable JS module) and UI (HTML/CSS).
relevant_files: index.html - main game file with HTML, CSS, and JS
minesweeper.test.js - automated tests for game logic
directory_structure: Root directory contains only README.md, test.md, work2.md. The game will be added at the root level.
